English.Char_Desc_250: GridFall is a free falling-block puzzle game for Windows. Fit the pieces together, clear rows and chase high scores across five modes: Marathon, Sprint, Ultra, Survival and Master. A single small .exe with nothing to install.
English.Char_Desc_450: GridFall is a free falling-block puzzle game for Windows. Fit the falling pieces together to complete rows and score points across five modes: endless Marathon, 40-line Sprint, three-minute Ultra, Survival with rising garbage rows, and Master, where pieces land instantly. English.Char_Desc_2000:
GridFall is a free falling-block puzzle game for Windows 10 and 11. Fit the falling pieces together to fill complete rows; full rows vanish and score points, and the game ends when the stack reaches the top. It is quick to pick up, with enough depth to keep experienced players busy.
Five game modes: - Marathon: endless play. The pieces fall faster every 10 lines, and you can choose a starting level from 1 to 15. - Sprint: clear 40 lines as fast as you can. The clock is the only score. - Ultra: three minutes to score as many points as possible. - Survival: garbage rows push up from below, faster and faster. Every line you clear cancels one. - Master: for experts. Pieces land instantly and the time to place them keeps shrinking. Clear 200 lines to finish.
Features: - Hold piece, five-piece preview and a ghost outline that shows where the piece will land. - Wall kicks, 180-degree rotation, T-spins, combos, back-to-back bonuses and perfect-clear bonuses. - Separate high-score table for every mode, with name entry. - Three colour themes, optional grid lines, particle effects and screen shake. - Adjustable key-repeat delay and rate for players who like fast, precise control. - Full screen or resizable window, sharp at any size. Menus work with keyboard or mouse. - Built-in sound effects with volume control.
GridFall is a single small program file. There is no installer, it needs no extra downloads, and it writes nothing to the registry: just unzip and run. Settings and high scores are kept in your user profile. It is completely free, with no adverts, no time limit and no locked features.
